name: shopily-html
description: Shopily - Multivendor eCommerce Website HTML Template
author: Laralink

scripts.build:css: sass --style=expanded --no-source-map assets/sass/style.scss assets/css/style.raw.css && postcss assets/css/style.raw.css --use autoprefixer --map -o assets/css/style.css && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('assets/css/style.raw.css')"
scripts.build:min: sass --style=compressed --no-source-map assets/sass/style.scss assets/css/style.min.raw.css && postcss assets/css/style.min.raw.css --use autoprefixer --no-map -o assets/css/style.min.css && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('assets/css/style.min.raw.css')"
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:min
